member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.ConstellationControllerBase.Logger
member.summary: Optional structured logger for operational events (worker lifecycle, eviction, proxy failures, cleanup). Records written inside a request or background span carry its trace and span ids, so a host that exports logs (for example Radiant to Loki) gets log-to-trace correlation. Default is a no-op logger; setting null restores the no-op logger. Set before calling ; worker sessions capture the logger in effect when they register. This is in addition to, not a replacement for, the SyslogLogging module.

member.name: T:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings
member.summary: Telemetry export settings consumed by the hosting application (for example Constellation.ControllerServer, which starts a Radiant host from these values). The controller library itself always emits through the BCL Constellation meter and activity source and does not read these settings; they exist so that one constellation.json configures the whole process. Watson's own HTTP telemetry is configured separately under Webserver.Telemetry. Loopback defaults use 127.0.0.1 rather than localhost. Thread safety: not thread safe; configure before starting the host.

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.Enable
member.summary: Master switch for exporting telemetry from the host. Default true. When false the host starts no exporter and every Constellation and Watson measurement remains a near-free no-op.

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.ServiceName
member.summary: Service name stamped as the service.name resource attribute. Default constellation-controller. Must be non-empty.
member.exception: Thrown when set to null or empty.

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.OtlpEnable
member.summary: Whether to push metrics, traces, and logs over OTLP. Default true.

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.OtlpEndpoint
member.summary: OTLP endpoint (an OpenTelemetry Collector, Tempo, or any OTLP backend). Default http://127.0.0.1:4317. Use the gRPC port (4317) with the grpc protocol, or the HTTP port (4318) with httpprotobuf. Must be an absolute URI.
member.exception: Thrown when the value is not an absolute URI.

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusEnable
member.summary: Whether to serve an in-process Prometheus scrape endpoint. Default true. The endpoint is anonymous; keep it on an internal interface.

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusHostname
member.summary: Hostname the Prometheus scrape endpoint binds to. Default 127.0.0.1. Inside a container, set this to the container's own hostname (for example constellation-controller) so the endpoint binds the address other containers reach. Wildcards (*, +) and 0.0.0.0 are rejected by the underlying OpenTelemetry Prometheus listener. Must be non-empty.
member.exception: Thrown when set to null or empty.

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusPort
member.summary: Port the Prometheus scrape endpoint binds to. Default 9464. Minimum 1, maximum 65535.

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.LokiEnable

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.LokiEndpoint
member.summary: Loki OTLP base endpoint. Default http://127.0.0.1:3100/otlp. Must be an absolute URI.

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.LokiTenantId

member.name: P:Constellation.Controller.TelemetrySettings.LogsMinimumSeverity

member.summary: Head-based trace sampling ratio, 0.0 (sample nothing) through 1.0 (sample everything). Default 1.0. Parent-based, so a sampled inbound trace keeps its children sampled.
